caseName: Woe v. Nebraska State Department of Public Welfare
caseNameFull: Woe v. Nebraska State Department of Public Welfare

opinions.text:
Application to vacate stay entered May 25, 1979, by the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit, addressed to Mr. Justice Marshall and referred to the Court, denied.

Mr. Justice White took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
